column1: # Local bypass for a Metalio E-Ink 4 unit with a deterministic bad flash
# sector at 0xEE000. Used only by [env:metalio_eink4] (development); nightly
# releases keep the shipping partitions.csv. See
# app0 is shifted from 0x10000 to 0xF0000 to skip the bad sector; the range
# 0x10000-0xF0000 is intentionally left unallocated. Both app slots keep
# 0x640000 so OTA and font-cache sizing are unchanged; the 896KB cost is taken
# from the unused spiffs partition. No SPIFFS is mounted by this firmware.
